name: GS.meetMan_worse_left
lines: n : ℕ
w m : Preferences n
μ ν : Matching (Fin n) (Fin n)
hμ : Matching.IsStable (MatchingMarket.ofEquivData w m) μ
hν : Matching.IsStable (MatchingMarket.ofEquivData w m) ν
i j : Fin n
hij : meetMan μ ν hμ hν i = j
hμij : wPartner μ hμ j = i
⊢ List.idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) (m.prefs j) ≤ List.idxOf i (m.prefs j)
hμm : mPartner μ hμ i = j
case pos
heq : mPartner ν hν i = j
case neg
heq : ¬mPartner ν hν i = j
this : wPartner ν hν j = i
hbranch : meetMan μ ν hμ hν i = mPartner μ hμ i
⊢ meetMan μ ν hμ hν i = mPartner μ hμ i
hle : List.idxOf (mPartner μ hμ i) (w.prefs i) ≤ List.idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) (w.prefs i)
⊢ List.idxOf (mPartner μ hμ i) (w.prefs i) ≤ List.idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) (w.prefs i)
hgt : ¬List.idxOf (mPartner μ hμ i) (w.prefs i) ≤ List.idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) (w.prefs i)
⊢ False
hbranch :
(if List.idxOf (mPartner μ hμ i) (w.prefs i) ≤ List.idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) (w.prefs i) then mPartner μ hμ i
else mPartner ν hν i) =
mPartner μ hμ i
hbranch : mPartner ν hν i = mPartner μ hμ i
hle : List.idxOf j (w.prefs i) ≤ List.idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) (w.prefs i)
hlt : List.idxOf j (w.prefs i) < List.idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) (w.prefs i)
⊢ List.idxOf j (w.prefs i) < List.idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) (w.prefs i)
e : List.idxOf j (w.prefs i) = List.idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) (w.prefs i)
⊢ mPartner ν hν i = j
this : List.idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) (m.prefs j) < List.idxOf i (m.prefs j)

steps.tactic: have hμm : mPartner μ hμ i = j := (wPartner_eq_iff μ hμ).mp hμij
by_cases heq : mPartner ν hν i = j
have : wPartner ν hν j = i := (wPartner_eq_iff ν hν).mpr heq
have hbranch : meetMan μ ν hμ hν i = mPartner μ hμ i := by rw [hij, hμm]

have hle : (w.prefs i).idxOf (mPartner μ hμ i) ≤ (w.prefs i).idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) :=
  by
  by_contra hgt
  unfold meetMan at hbranch
  rw [if_neg hgt] at hbranch
  exact heq (hbranch.trans hμm)

have hlt : (w.prefs i).idxOf j < (w.prefs i).idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) :=
  by
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne hle (fun e => heq ?_)
  exact ((List.idxOf_inj (pref_list_mem _ (w.valid i).1 (w.valid i).2 j)).mp e).symm

have :=
  opposed_preferences_women ν hν (mi := j) (mi' := mPartner ν hν i) (j' := wPartner ν hν j) (matchM_mPartner ν hν i) hlt
    (matchW_wPartner ν hν j)
